title: Hezo Link problem V1
description: Strict public RFC 9457-style problem shape. Format-aware URI-reference validation and semantic UTF-8 byte validation are required in addition to this schema.

type.description: Nonempty ASCII RFC 3986 URI reference. The ASCII constraint makes the code-point maximum equal to the UTF-8 byte maximum. Validators must assert the uri-reference format, including percent-escape syntax.

title.description: Bounded approved title with no Unicode control or format characters. Semantic validation additionally enforces the 128 UTF-8 byte maximum.

code.description: Forward-compatible lower-snake-case ASCII code. The first character is a lowercase letter; doubled and trailing underscores are rejected.

detail.description: Bounded non-sensitive copy with no Unicode control or format characters. Semantic validation additionally enforces the 512 UTF-8 byte maximum.

retry_after_seconds.description: Optional retry delay. Presence requires retryable to be true.
